objectives.title: Map the AI Landscape

objectives.title: Set Up Your Toolkit

agenda.title: Welcome & The Week You Walked In
agenda.description: Who I am, why this course exists, and the eight days of AI history you just lived through.
bulletPoints: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Gemini 3.8 all shipped in the last eight days
Course promise: you will ship a working AI agent this semester

agenda.title: Introductions
agenda.description: Name, major, and one thing you wish AI would do for you — we'll check back in December.

agenda.title: The State of AI in Business
agenda.description: The numbers behind the hype — and the adoption-to-scaling gap where careers are made.
bulletPoints: 91% of businesses use AI; 79% are adopting agents — but only 23% are scaling them
That gap is the syllabus of this course

agenda.title: Live Demo: A Frontier Model at Work
agenda.description: No slides. We give a frontier model a real business problem and watch what happens.
bulletPoints: Question → research → analysis → deliverable in one conversation
Where it shines, where it stumbles — and why you need to know the difference

agenda.title: Hands-On: Build a Language Model by Counting
agenda.description: Open Colab and run Act 1 of the Tiny LLM notebook together — a model made of pure counting that invents new names.
bulletPoints: A working language model with zero math beyond tallying
Turn the temperature dial — the same creativity knob in the real APIs

agenda.title: Roadmap, Homework #1 & Q&A
agenda.description: The semester arc, how you're graded, and your first homework: train a real transformer tonight.
bulletPoints: Homework #1: finish the notebook at home (Acts 2-3) and post your favorite generated name on Canvas before Monday
Final Project: build an agent that solves a real problem — due Wed Dec 9 at 11:59 PM

resources.title: Session 1 Slide Deck
resources.description: The 16-slide presentation deck for class: the release-wave timeline, business stats, hands-on launch with QR code, Homework #1, and the semester roadmap. Arrow keys to navigate, F for fullscreen.

resources.title: Session 1 Lecture Guide
resources.description: The full interactive lecture guide: last week's release wave, the state of AI in business (September 2026), today's agenda, and your setup checklist.

resources.title: Train Your Own Tiny LLM — Colab Notebook
resources.description: The Session 1 hands-on and Homework #1: build a language model by counting (Act 1, in class), then train a real 100,000-parameter transformer at home (Acts 2-3, due before Monday). Runs free in your browser, no API keys.

resources.title: AI: From Neurons to LLMs (PDF)
resources.description: Background reading that bridges today's tiny model to Session 2: how neural networks scale up into the large language models running the modern AI economy.

resources.title: Karpathy's makemore & nanochat
resources.description: The projects that inspired today's exercise. nanochat is a full ChatGPT-style pipeline you can train for about $100 — the best deep dive on how LLMs really get built.
